annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at regular intervals of 2 units. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU," also on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 2 units. The plot features three lines: a blue dashed line with circle markers, an orange dashed line with triangle markers, and a green dashed line with square markers. The blue line begins at AL 0 with a BLEU score of slightly below 20 and ends at AL 8 with a score of slightly above 28, showing a steady increase throughout. The orange line starts at AL 0 with a BLEU score just above 24, reaching nearly 29 at AL 8 with consistent upward movement. The green line starts at AL 0 with a BLEU score slightly above 23 and ends at AL 8 close to 29, also demonstrating an overall upward trend. The orange line intersects with the green line at an x-value of 6. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
